continuationGovernor.stopReason: Owner selected the launch architecture: existing ISSUED ONCE website + Safepay for customer payment + owner-controlled manual Printful manufacturing payment/approval for the first complete real cycle, with a later Stripe migration after demand validation and an eligible entity. The architectural design has been written and committed. Per the approved engineering process, implementation must not begin until the owner reviews the written spec.

rules: Treat mapped GitHub repo/branch as canonical source of truth
Use test-first changes for behavior and bug fixes
Keep production and preview/runtime boundaries fail-closed
Never call a gate green when the runner did not execute
Update this continuation state after every meaningful work cycle

lastMeaningfulCycle.objective: Lock the simplest architecture capable of proving one complete paid ISSUED ONCE order from randomized private questions through payment, design, manufacturing, shipment and customer delivery before optimizing fees or incorporating a foreign payment entity.
changes: Selected the existing ISSUED ONCE Next.js website as the only customer storefront; Shopify and Fourthwall are out of the first-cycle architecture
Selected Safepay as the launch customer-payment adapter while keeping payment infrastructure behind a replaceable PaymentGateway boundary
Explicitly accepted Safepay-to-bank-to-Printful money movement and its temporary fee/FX inefficiency as validation cost
Selected Printful as the first ManufacturerGateway with manufacturing manually approved/paid for the first cycle
Required paid orders to remain blocked from manufacturing until the design and production-quality gates pass
Defined the immutable identity spine from Experience -> Question Set -> Answers -> Contact -> Physical Selection -> Payment Attempt -> Issue -> Design Job -> Manufacturing Job -> Shipment
Defined a versioned randomized Question Vault with seven distinct design-signal families so different customers can receive different questions without sacrificing useful creative information
Kept raw answers encrypted and excluded from Safepay and Printful
Added verified-email OTP requirements without requiring a customer password/account
Assigned shipping-address collection to ISSUED ONCE because Safepay is only the payment processor in this architecture
Defined customer status projection, support-by-Issue-Code, failure handling, and first-cycle acceptance criteria
Defined future migration from SafepayPaymentGateway to StripePaymentGateway after commercial validation and eligible entity formation without rewriting the product/domain core

verification.lastFullCiAtThatHead: GREEN unit tests + typecheck + production build

lastMeaningfulCycle.ownerAction: Review docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-19-issued-once-safepay-printful-mvp-design.md. If it matches the intended first-cycle workflow, approve the written spec so the next step can be the implementation plan.
nextActions: After owner approval of the written spec, create the implementation plan before touching production behavior
Implement the Question Vault and persistent randomized seven-question assignment test-first
Implement verified contact/OTP and encrypted shipping identity
Replace the future commerce path with a Safepay PaymentGateway while keeping current production writes fail-closed until configured
Create the Issue/design/manufacturing identity links and manual Printful approval workflow
Build the private Issue status/support path and event-driven customer updates
Run one controlled end-to-end paid cycle before automating Printful confirmation or optimizing payment economics
If the commercial cycle validates demand, evaluate an eligible entity and migrate the payment adapter to Stripe without changing the domain core
Restore executable CI/Browser QA runner availability before claiming final production gates green
